message: Found usage of eval()/exec()/system() in main.java. Note: Flagged as High Severity injection vulnerability.
Source files are placed in root.
Project lacks a dedicated tests directory.
Project has neither requirements.txt nor package.json.
Project lacks an example environment variables file.
Runtime.exec() executes an OS command. Attacker-controlled input leads to OS command injection (CWE-78). Use ProcessBuilder with a string[] argument and validate all inputs.
